svg.title: Two ways to be unsafe
svg.desc: Left, ISO 26262: a fault makes the robotaxi accelerate when nothing asked it to; safety goal SG-01, Avoid unintended acceleration, ASIL D. Right, ISO 21448: nothing has failed, but low sun dazzles the sensors and a pedestrian on the crosswalk may not be detected; WP-C-02 says low sun and glare are triggering conditions (WP-C-06).

g.text: For example SG-01: avoid unintended acceleration
Nothing fails, but it is not good enough
For example: low sun and glare are triggering conditions (WP-C-06)
Functional safety asks what happens when something fails; SOTIF asks what happens when nothing fails but the function is not good enough.
